register.labelZh: TUNE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tune in 可以表示在電視、電台或網上節目開始時收看或收聽。；訊號需要變得清晰時,可以使用 tune something in;選擇特定電台或頻道時,則可以使用 tunesomething to something。；tune out 可以表示不再留意說話或聲音;be tuned in to something 則可以表示了解別人的感受或需要。；tune up 可以自然地描述樂手在演奏前為樂器調音。
register.summaryEn: Tune in helps you describe joining a television, radio or online programme when it begins. You can use tune something in when the signal needs to become clearer and tune something to something when selecting a particular station or channel. Tune out describes ignoring speech or sound, while be tuned in to something describes understanding people’s feelings or needs. Tune up gives you a natural way to describe musicians adjusting their instruments before playing.
